hero.title: The travel app built by
hero.subtitle: Create day-by-day travel guides with real stops, maps and photos — and discover trips shared by people who've actually been there. No ads. No influencers. Just honest travel.

tagline.heading: Real itineraries from real travelers.
tagline.sub: Not AI-generated. Not sponsored. Just people who have been there — sharing exactly where they went and what they did.

features.heading: Everything you need to travel smarter
features.sub: Built for travelers who plan carefully and share generously.

items.title: Day-by-day itineraries

items.title: Discover real trips
items.desc: Browse guides from real travelers. Hidden gems you won't find on any algorithm.

items.title: Map integration

items.title: Build it your way
